_readme: Mount Etna start-up montage, the same mechanism as /load_screen/earth: frames play in this order from this folder, and adding a photograph plus a line here is the whole change. hold_ms is how long a frame holds, fade_ms the dissolve; the page fetches this file fresh on every start, so an edit shows on the next load.
_sources: EVERY FRAME IS RE-ENCODED TO A BYTE BUDGET (<=1600x1000, WebP, under ~190 kB each). A start screen fetches its pictures while the viewer behind it fetches its own terrain and geology on the same connection, so a heavy frame is a slower hand-over. Six frames, about 590 kB.
_credits: 04 came in named as iStock 000069407417 and is credited as stock. 01, 02, 05 are carried from the earlier set as GeoID's own. 03 is NASA. 07 arrived without a source and is captioned without one rather than being given a credit it may not have. Esri's World Imagery is deliberately absent even though the viewer draws it: it is licence-conditional, and a start screen is shown to every visitor rather than chosen by one.
